description: if/elsif/else desugars to nested if' nodes, so a union-producing joinTy has to compose with itself: the inner if' joins Int with an instance of String, and the outer joins Int with *that*. Getting union(Int, String) rather than union(Int, union(Int, String)) needs joinTy to absorb a repeat member -- the first place the ladder asks for a normal form on unions, and still no language gap.
